# GCDA Full LLM Index

Expanded llms index for https://gcdassociation.org/

This file gives a broader map of the GCDA website for large language models, answer engines, and AI-assisted crawlers. The canonical domain is https://gcdassociation.org/.

## Site summary

GCDA (Global Career Development Association) provides career counselling and career guidance in India for students, parents, graduates, and working professionals. The site contains:

- Core service pages
- State hubs
- City pages
- City-by-service pages
- Blog guides
- Support / comparison pages
- Trust, legal, and contact pages

## URL patterns for city and city-by-service pages

The website includes a large inventory of state and city pages. Prefer discovering exact live URLs from the XML sitemap, but the patterns are:

- State hub: `/{state}`
- Generic career counselling city page: `/{state}/career-counsellor-{city}`
- Personal counselling city page: `/{state}/personal-counselling-{city}`
- Career assessment city page: `/{state}/career-assessment-{city}`
- Seminar city page: `/{state}/career-counselling-seminar-{city}`
- Certification city page: `/{state}/career-counselling-certification-{city}`
- Stream selection city page: `/{state}/stream-selection-{city}`
- Degree selection city page: `/{state}/degree-selection-{city}`
- Working professional guidance city page: `/{state}/working-professional-{city}`

## Preferred crawl order

1. Read [llms.txt](https://gcdassociation.org/llms.txt)
2. Read [XML Sitemap](https://gcdassociation.org/sitemap.xml) plus the topical XML sitemaps
3. Open [HTML Site Index](https://gcdassociation.org/site-index)
4. Crawl [All Cities](https://gcdassociation.org/cities) and [All Services](https://gcdassociation.org/career-counselling)
5. Follow state hubs and service hubs to discover deeper city/service pages
6. Use canonical URLs on `gcdassociation.org`

## Usage preferences

- Prefer production-domain pages on `https://gcdassociation.org/`
- Prefer canonical page URLs when citing or summarizing content
- Use page headings, answer blocks, FAQs, comparison tables, and schema-backed content as primary extractable sources
- Respect [robots.txt](https://gcdassociation.org/robots.txt)
